definitions.explanation: Describing a person, ability, or achievement that is exceptionally good, particularly in academic, professional, or competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ。

{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧⟦{体系|たいけい}→体系：04487_taikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}した→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: We revised the salary structure in order to secure talented personnel.

notes:
A な-adjective from the noun ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧, composed of ⟦{優|ゆう}→優：00431_yuu⟧ (superior, gentle) + {秀|しゅう} (excel, outstanding). One of the most common words for praising someone's abilities or achievements.

USAGE:
Used mainly for people and their abilities or work. Less commonly applied to physical objects. Often appears in formal evaluations, academic contexts, and business language. Can be used as a noun modifier ({優秀|ゆうしゅう}な⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧) or as a predicate (⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧ — talented personnel
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ — excellent grades
- ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧ — excellence award
- ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧{優秀者|ゆうしゅうしゃ} — top achiever, honors student

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧ — excellent, superior (broader usage; can describe things and qualities)
- ⟦{有能|ゆうのう}→有能：03650_yuunou⟧な — competent, capable (emphasizes practical ability over academic achievement)
- ⟦{秀逸|しゅういつ}→秀逸：21962_shuuitsu⟧な — superb, exceptional (more literary; often for creative works)
